result.summary: The page overall looks well-structured with only minor visual inconsistencies found, mainly related to inconsistent heart icon styling and category card layout differences.

issues.description: The favorite/heart icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card has a white circular background while the heart icon on the pizza card below has a dark/black circular background, creating inconsistent styling between similar elements.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button background color/opacity across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' section, the food images for 'Green Bowl Poke' and 'Trattoria Piccolo' are shown as small circular plates on a light gray background, while 'Smash Bros Burgers' uses a full-bleed dark background image, resulting in inconsistent card imagery treatment.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image style (either full-bleed photos or circular icons) across all cards in the same carousel.
